'''Massassi One''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] utilized it in the course of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] missions and during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] search for a base and allies.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' claims that Luke used this call sign, but in [[Tatooine Sojourn]] he is speaking with Massassi-One, not as Massassi-One.
